channel.title: NPR Programs: Morning Edition
channel.description: Morning Edition takes listeners around the country and the world with multi-faceted stories and commentaries every weekday. Hosts Steve Inskeep, Leila Fadel, Michel Martin and A Martínez bring you the latest breaking news and features to prepare you for the day.

item.title: Gloria Steinem, trailblazing journalist and activist, has died
item.description: Feminist icon and author Gloria Steinem has died. Her foundation posted online this morning that she died yesterday in New York City.
item.content:encoded: Feminist icon and author Gloria Steinem has died. Her foundation posted online this morning that she died yesterday in New York City.

item.title: Families of the missing in Nepal's flash floods perform symbolic cremations
item.description: Eight days after Nepal's flash floods, families who can't find loved ones perform symbolic cremations.

item.title: Jury is deadlocked in Lindsay Clancy's trial
item.description: Jurors in the trial of Lindsay Clancy, the Massachusetts woman charged with murdering her three children, are deadlocked after five days of deliberation.

item.description: NPR's Michel Martin speaks with CNN senior political analyst Ron Brownstein about the Democratic Party's division over embracing democratic socialism.

item.description: Xi Jinping's visit to Egypt for the first time in a decade, and during the Iran war, comes as U.S. allies broaden their security ties.

item.description: NPR's Michel Martin asks former Obama administration official Benjamin Gedan about the viability of the Trump administration's plan for Venezuelan oil.

item.title: Critics question legality of Venezuela oil deals
item.description: Chevron's $7 billion Venezuela bet deepens U.S. ties to the country's oil industry. Critics say the deal poses risks to democracy and could fuel discontent over Washington's embrace of the government.

item.title: NBA punishes LA Clippers over salary cap scheme
item.description: The NBA has punished the Los Angeles Clippers for a scheme it says tried to circumvent the salary cap to pay Kawhi Leonard. The team will lose five years of first-round picks plus millions in fines.

item.title: U.S.-Israel relations are on the rocks ahead of elections
item.description: Relations between the Trump administration and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu have turned rocky since Trump called a truce with Iran. Trump seeks progress in Gaza, but Netanyahu is taking a defiant stance ahead of an election.
